items.title: President Rottinghands McCankles cancels his remaining rallies. What a fucking loser.
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Yesterday evening, out of the clear blue and without warning, the White House abruptly announced that all of Dear Leader’s upcoming weekend rallies had been canceled — fuckity-bye, hit the bricks, sayonara — thereby depriving his remaining cultists the opportunity to sit uncomfortably on a folding chair in a thimble-sized gymnasium, and listen to Donny ramble incoherently for two entire hours about how he successfully pointed at the drawing of the camel, all while being drowned out by an endless series of hecklers.

Reporter Jacob Bogage: “So you not going to Kansas has nothing to do with you being sick of traveling?”

Donny: “Oh, you’re sick to ask that question. You are sick. Who are you with?”

Bogage:

Donny: “You are a sick guy. Reuters is terrible. Can you imagine? Look at this guy. He’s way out of shape. Look at how bent— he comes [makes accordion hands] he comes to me. ‘Sir, you’re not gonna go to Kansas.’ I’m not going to Kansan because he’s doing very well. We’re gonna do a tele-rally’ … but he says, ‘you’re not going to Kansas, sir, are you feeling well?’ You’ve been following me for two weeks. I feel perfect. You are disgusting. Put yourself in shape. You look like hell.”

Wow, Dear Leader sure gets cranky when he’s got a full load in his diaper — and he didn’t even hear the question correctly. Did you catch that? The reporter asks Donny if he’s and Donny goes ballistic because all he hears is And he automatically explodes into some infantile rant about ‘I’m not sick, you’re sick’ — because he’s got the emotional maturity of a four-year-old.

Maybe Donny needs to get his ears checked.

Is this a piece of your brain, Donny?

Dear Leader can’t hack it any more. He’s too old and tired and demented to be flying across the country every single goddamned day. Plus, he’s fed up. He loves the crowds — only this time around, there aren’t any crowds. All that remains are the die-hard, brain-deadest cultists — and there aren’t even enough of them left to fill the pint-sized high school gyms his flunkies are booking him into. How long before Donny has to open for a

‘Oh Natty, you’re the only one who understands me.’

I think I just threw up in my own mouth a little.

So now, if you’re a cultist and you need your Donny fix this weekend, you’re going to have to zoom in to some ‘tele-rally,’ and watch Dear Leader sitting behind the Resolute Desk, drooling all over himself as he gradually loses consciousness. It’ll be just like a real rally, except you won’t be able to smell the farts.

Meanwhile, let’s go live to Republican National Headquarters for the GOP’s reaction to Donny having canceled his remaining rallies.

“Sources say, though, that some Republican officials are relieved by the president’s decision to cancel those final two rallies. One top Republican official told my colleague Jeff Zeleny, quote, ‘thank God. He hasn’t moved the needle anywhere.’ And a second official, saying, quote, ‘everyone has seen the president who wants to see him.’”

Boo fucking hoo, Republicans. Maybe it was a mistake to hitch your wagons to an increasingly-befuddled fascist who, thanks to an increasing fog of dementia and untreated tertiary syphilis, no longer has any idea which end is up.

Reporter: “Have you heard that Lt. General Sylvia leaked classified information at the Pentagon?”

Reporter: “I said, Lt. General Sylvia leaked classified information at the Pentagon.”

Donny: “ got problems. gonna have big problems. did. We’re very much looking for leakers, and uh—gonna have big problems.”

Surely, Donny can’t be this seriously misinformed, can he?

Spoiler alert: yes he can be this misinformed. Remember, Donny’s daily intel briefing has been boiled to down to a single page of bullet points and burlesque photos from the 1940s.

That’s the only thing that will hold Donny’s attention. So he hasn’t a fucking clue who Lt. General Sylvia is. All he hears is the name ‘Sylvia’ and away he goes, blithering about the retribution he’s going to inflict on some imaginary woman who doesn’t exist.

I’m so old, I remember when Job Biden would occasionally stumble over someone’s name, and would have to correct himself. The press would have a field day, and start filling editorial pages with piece after piece about how Sleepy Joe was too old and icky and smelly do to his job, and how he needs to step down, right now, for the good of the country.

Now we have an actual cognitively-collapsed president concocting fairy tales about strange generals, lying in ponds, distributing leaks — and not one worthless scribbler of the corporate-controlled press can be bothered to say one word about it.

It’s so embarrassing to have a President of the United States who is an uninformed fool who has no fucking clue what’s going on inside his own government, and just makes shit up on the spot, based on what’s he’s

But tell me once again how it was Joe Biden who was the real problem. That’s such an awesome story.

I swear, I yam disgustipated.

Fox News bobblehead: “Tom, why are you here this morning?”

Tom: “Well, in the late 70s, I was a little too young to get involved and go to South America for the Jonestown Massacre. But this is as close as I’ll ever get, so that’s why I’m here.”

Bobblehead: “Wait, the Jonestown Massacre?”

Tom: “That’s right. There’s nothing like seeing a cult right up front, man.”

Bobblehead: “Maybe this is not a Trump supporter [walks away dejectedly]

And right there, that’s your problem for Fox news — and for all the wingnut media right now. When there are too few cultists in the crowd, it’s way too easy for any mischief-maker to walk up to the dude holding the microphone, and go

Masterful job, bro. Norway will be in touch to let you know when you can pick up your Nobel Trolling Prize.

[Oh, and that scream you just heard, that was me — because this is where I was in writing this post when I got the notification on my phone about Donny going ahead with the canceled rallies. I was this fucking close, man.]

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here are three photos off the same roll of film from the early 1990s. First, we have Ms Spouse setting up a slide for Katie, in our back yard.

Second, Ms Spouse in a hotel room in Plymouth, MA.

And lastly, Katie and her mom, on the beach in Plymouth.

Have a great Friday, everyone. May you have better timing than me, when news is breaking.

items.title: Barack Obama is basically now just farting in Preznit Fuckwit’s general direction
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
We’re going get to Barack HUSSEIN Obama taunting Donny a, I promise.

But first, we need to put our Hero of the Day right up top. At a hate-rally in Mississippi two days ago, this loyal, patriotic American had a heartfelt message of undying affection and support for Dear Leader. Let’s give it a listen.

“Release the Epstein Files! Shove that ballroom up your fat ass!”

How sad is it for Donny that he’s now been reduced to campaigning in such tiny little rinky-dink venues — high school gymnasiums and the like — that it only takes one determined heckler with a good set of lungs to throw the whole event off the rails?

Wait, did I say sad? I meant to say . Shoot that shit straight into my veins.

Honestly, I think Donny’s already got his beloved Epstein Dance Hall shoved up his fat ass. That’s the only reasonable explanation whatever the hell is going on back there these days.

And now, on to the main event. Remember the other day, when Obama thoroughly humiliated Donny by pointing that that the Oval Bordello has been tatted up with so much golden crap that it now ‘looks like Saddam Hussein opened up a Cheesecake Factory’?

Trump is BIG MAD about Obama saying the White House now looks like Saddam opened a Cheesecake Factory: “He’s not a smart guy. He's not smart at all ... for you to say it’s a Cheesecake Factory, that just shows why you were a lousy president.”

Shut the fuck up, Donny. Grow a sense of humor.

So of course, when faced with such an irresistible, thin-skinned piss-baby target, Obama did the only logical thing.

“What I said about them being directly responsible for rising prices, they did not argue with that. They did not deny that tariffs were contributing to higher costs per family. They didn’t say anything about that. I accused this administration, based on the facts, that they were engaging in unprecedented levels of corruption, they didn’t say anything about that. The president wasn’t even mad about the Saddam Hussein comparison. That part didn’t bother him. But he was very upset about the Cheesecake Factory comments. He took great umbrage. He said I didn’t understand the work of the artisans in the White House.

And they mobilized — it’s all crazy, but this is the crazy part — they mobilized a whole government response to that joke. Not to inflation, but to that joke. The White House even called the Secretary of the Treasury. This is the man who is in charge of the economy. The person who’s supposed to be figuring out how to make your life more affordable. The guy who’s supposed to be figuring out how to lower inflation. And reduce interest rates. They told him he should hold a press conference in front of the Cheesecake Factory.”

Come on, we’re supposed to believe that the guy who probably throws a thermonuclear shit-fit when the sommelier bring out the wrong vintage of Lafitte Rothschild — ‘I said the ’75, you peasant, not the ’76, what is wrong with you’ — is chowing down at any place with ‘factory’ in its name?

Bessent is the kind of shitweasel who goes ballistic if the valet leaves a fingerprint on the door of his Bentley. He’s not jamming any ‘French-dip cheeseburgers’ down his gullet.

As Obama so correctly points out, Scott Bessent has actual, important job that he should be busy with — but instead of doing any of that shit, Donny makes him drop everything to go stand in front of the nearest camera.

These are not serious people. They’re all fucking embarrassments.

None of Donny’s flunkies have any fucking idea how to their jobs. They have no clue how to fix any of the shit they’ve broken. All they want is to be famous and on TV. Instead of winning the unwinnable war he started, Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand holds useless photo-ops where he does the shittiest pull-ups you’ll even see. Why? How is that even relevant to anything related to his actual job?‘Gaze in awe at my weak-ass pullups.’ Yay, Pete.

The Secretary of Transportation has a reality show that no one watches. The Secretary of Health has a cooking show. Even Dear Leader has his own TV channel.

Remember that, the youtube channel that Dear Leader started when the networks held their impotent, one-day boycott of the White House press office? Of course you don’t remember. No one fucking remembers. But it’s still here, watched by absolutely nobody.

The only member of the Donnyverse who isn’t super horny to get himself on TV is Marco Rubio. He hides out in who the fuck even knows where he is, because he’s terrified that some reporter might ask him why he’s wearing oversized clown shoes.

Check out this shoebox. Can you guess what it is?

This is the Ohio venue where Donny held last night’s hate-rally. My god, it’s another tiny little gymnasium. How fucking pathetic. You can really feel the , can’t you? It’s five days before what’s probably the most consequential election of our lifetime, and the President of the United States can’t fill a room that holds three hundred people.

Now, remember what I said up top about how in a venue that small, any determined heckler with a powerful set of lungs could derail the whole thing, and make it come crashing to the ground?

“Trump went on the Jeffrey Epstein plane! Trump went on the Jeffrey Epstein plane! Butterscotch Hitler! Pumpkin Spice Pedo! Butterscotch Hitler! Pumpkin Spice Pedo! Ah ha ha ha!”

‘Pumpkin Spice Pedo,’ how fucking perfect is that? No notes.

I also love the way this guy manages to keep filming — and keep heckling — even as he’s wrestled to the ground by MAGA chuds and escorted all the way to the sidewalk by security.

This one’s for you, ma’am.

Let’s have some more selfies from Ms Spouse’s phone. First, at Harvest On Hudson on December 17, 2025.

Have a great Thursday, everyone.

items.title: Happy 4th birthday to us all!
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Four years ago today, I created this newsletter with the half-baked notion that I might try my hand at writing something longer than a tweet.

I had no expectations of . If I had, I might have spent more than ninety seconds coming up with the name for this site.

I figured I might write a couple of things a week for a little while, grow tired of it, and then move on to the next shiny object.

that’s not how shit went down at all Here we are, four years later — and wow, .

That is flattering and humbling and … I really didn’t see it coming.

FOLKS, YOU ALL FUCKING RULE.

I want to thank everyone who signed up to receive the emails — and I especially want to thank all the people who have become commenters here.

Really. I reading your comments. I love it when you folks banter with each other. So many of you are clearly wittier and more knowledgeable than I — and I that.

It’s nice to be part of something positive — and not, like so much of the internet, toxic and hateful — and I have all of you folks to thank for that. have made this place what it is.

Without you, I’d just be shouting into the wind — and that shit gets old .

Let me once again take a moment to say thank you to the thousands of people who have posted, commented, private messaged, texted, and phoned to offer condolences. I love you all. I am blessed to be surrounded by an amazing, caring community. I love you all.

Thank you for hanging in there with me.

And, on that note, let us now have our Daily Claudia.

Today, Ms Spouse is going to blow out the birthday candles — first at the Hudson Valley Steakhouse in Yorktown Heights, NY, on February 11, 2022.

Have a great Wednesday, everyone. I’ll be back tomorrow, as always, to document the atrocities.

Happy fourth fucking birthday to all of us.

items.title: I’m so fucking tired of this election cycle
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Once again, these fucking fucks have me completely fucking exhausted. Every morning is like, ‘oh my god, what stupid shit are they going to pull today?’

It’s all so eternally . The relentless barrage of flimsy lies. The flop-sweat desperation of losing losers who know they’re going to lose. The nonstop bigotry, misogyny, transphobia and Islamophobia of d-list demagogues trying to terrify people into voting for them.

And it just keeps on getting stupider.

Do we all really have to endure the next seven days? Can’t we just magically skip ahead to next Wednesday, when we all wake up into a world where the fuckfaces have lost?

Anybody reporting Voter Fraud in the past Elections, or the upcoming 2026 Midterm Election, will be paid $1,000,000 upon the arrest and conviction of those that created the Fraud! Thank you for your attention to this matter. President DONALD J. TRUMP

Jesus H. Christ on a cockeyed catamaran, are you kidding me with this nonsense? It’s just one cheesy after another with this imbecile.

How many times has Dear Leader tried to bribe the morons into voting for him? First he promised that everyone would get a check for five grand if Republicans won the midterms. Next, he promised to bestow a 1% bounty on anyone who blew the whistle on corporate fraud.

Of course this penny-ante con artist has no intention of following through on any of his worthless promises, but try explaining that to the cultists.

And now, this latest lie, the vow to fork over a cool mil to anyone who roots out

That’s all I need, some vigilante dipshit in a MAGA hat, skulking about my polling place, while I’m trying to fill out my ballot. He’s there because Dear Leader promised him ONE MILLION DOLLARS.

Go the fuck home, dumb-ass. You’ve fallen for it again. You’re not getting shit from Dear Leader, and you’re just getting in everyone’s way.

“There’s five hundred million Arabs in the world. And yet they don't produce science. They don’t win the Nobel Prize. They don’t win the Fields Prize. They don’t win the Wolf Prize. They don’t produce literature.”

Could the Marvelous Mister Measles please stop gargling with the Drano?

Where is Bobby Brainworms Jr getting his information? This isn’t even racism. It’s ignorant bullshit. For fuck’s sake, dude went to Harvard. Didn’t he learn anything while there, aside from the best kind of toilet seat to snort coke off of? It’s a legit question to ask, because Brainworms, you’ll be shocked to hear, is spewing complete nonsense.

Do you know why our modern orthographic system of numbers are called ‘Arabic numerals’? It’s because the Arabs that shit.

If it weren’t for what some Arab dude named Muhammad ibn Musa al-Khwarizmi worked out , right now we’d be dicking around with trying to figure out the square root of MCXXVIII. Good luck with that, hotshot.

Instead of denigrating Arabs, Bobby Brainworms should go thank one.

Around 9 to 12 Arabs or individuals of direct Arab origin/nationality have won Nobel Prizes, depending on how “Arab” is defined (such as including the diaspora or specific national origins). [1, 2]

Prominent Arab laureates include Nobel Peace Prize winners Anwar Sadat (Egypt, 1978), Yasser Arafat (Palestine, 1994), Mohamed ElBaradei (Egypt, 2005, jointly with the IAEA), Tawakkol Karman (Yemen, 2011), and Nadia Murad (Iraq, 2018) for their peacebuilding and human rights efforts. In science and literature, laureates include Naguib Mahfouz (Egypt, 1988, Literature) and Ahmed Zewail (Egypt, 1999, Chemistry). [1, 2, 3]

Where’s rinky-dink award?

“Gas prices are too high ... they skyrocket every time some tinpot dictator decides to throw a tantrum.”

Hang on there — did Couchfuck just blunder into committing an honesty?

Because he’s right. There is one tinpot dictator in particular, who, every time he opens his rancid anus-mouth, causes the price of to skyrocket. You know who I’m talking about.

Bro, Donny’s going throw a massive shit-fit when he discovers you’ve been trash-talking him to a half-dozen MAGA jamokes in some high-school gymnasium.

Couchfuck so terrible at this. If I were a Republican candidate, and they told me that Mr. Heartbeat Away was coming to campaign for me, I’d change the locks and pretend I wasn’t home.

I’m so fucking tired of every one of these shit-weasels contriving to escape accountability.

Check out Piss-Drunk Pete Kegstand, our butt-dialing Secretary of Death. He knows that the long knives are out for him. He knows that if the Dems retake Congress, he’s right up top of the list of fucksticks who are going to get the shit impeached out of them.

Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is reportedly “angling” for a Senate seat over fears House Democrats plan to launch an impeachment investigation into his tenure after the midterms.

According to Puck, the secretary is interested in succeeding Tennessee’s incumbent Republican Sen. Marsha Blackburn should she win her race to be the state’s next governor against Democratic rival Jerri Green, as she is currently on course to do.

Oh great, in the event of Tennessee Senator Marsha Bag-of-Hair becoming Governor Bag-Of-Hair, Piss-Drunk Pete is going to pester her until she hands him her old job, thereby weaseling out of being impeached for being absolute shit at

Oh yeah, that’ll be awesome. Can you imagine the dumbfuckery that Piss-Drunk Pete could get up into, if he were to become the Esteemed Senator Kegstand? He could fire all the fatties and the beardos among his Senate staffers. I’m sure there’s some irreplaceable historic globe somewhere in the halls of the Capitol Building he can drunkenly trip over and destroy.

Oh, and he can demand to check the t-levels of Mitch McConnell.

Let’s hope that Piss-Drunk Pete’s plan to do an end-run around accountability works out as well as his plan to not flip a skateboard up into his own nuts.

It’s all so exhausting. Isn’t there some way to avoid this?

Can’t we all just vote early, and then ourselves through the next seven days, waking up into a better world? Wouldn’t that be fucking awesome?

Yeah, but then we’d miss seven days of the Daily Claudia. That would

Today, let’s have some covid-era fun. First up, it’s in the back yard with Tenchi the Wonder Cat, on June 3, 2020.

Next, chilling by the woodshed, on April 4, 2020.

And, lastly, kinda-sorta socially distancing down at the lake with Scott, Kathy and Adela, on June 21, 2020.

Have a great Tuesday, everyone!

items.title: Obama dissed the Oval Bordello, and MAGA completely lost its shit
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Folks, pour one out for the whiniest little diaper-babies in the world. They’re going through some things right now.

Once again, the entire wingnut outrage-industrial complex has whipped itself into a pants-shitting frenzy over some stupid bullshit that not one sane person gives a single small-batch artisanal fuck about.

Seriously, what in the hallowed name of Performative-Nonsense Jesus is?

Makes speeches for 500k a pop. Hasn’t eaten dinner that costs less than $250 in years. Has never been in a Cheesecake Factory. Undefeated at condescending to regular folks. Will always be known for a presidency that ushered in the Trump era to begin with.

That’s right, folks. The entire MAGAsphere is shitting one massive brick right now, all because Barack HUSSEIN Obama had the utter gall to make the objectively accurate observation that Dear Leader’s Oval Bordello has been tatted up with so much gold-plated crap that it now looks like ‘Saddam Hussein opened up a Cheesecake Factory.’

My dudes, can we talk? What are you so worked up over? That shit’s funny as fuck. Grow a sense of humor and get on with your sad and empty little lives.

What a goddamned waste of everyone’s time — yet here comes CNN’s Scott Jennings to lead the way. His problem with Obama is that he’s some out-of-touch elitist who has no business trashing where hard-working Americans eat.

I mean, Obama probably even drinks espresso with his pinky in the air. Who the fuck does Obama think he is?

You want to talk about ? Let’s do us a quick chat about the Fucknut-in-Chief in that Oval Bordello.

Donny Convict was born into obscene wealth. He’s never held an actual job, and he’s never done an honest day’s labor in his life. When he’s not playing president, he lives on a golf course. He’s squandered multiple fortunes — because he knows that there will always be some gullible banker or Russian mobster willing to bail him out. He lives in a soft, pampered bubble. He has no idea what anything costs, and he doesn’t care. He’s always had a staff to do everything for him. He’s never pumped his own gas, or hauled his own trash cans to the curb.

But sure, let’s pretend that Barack Obama — who came from humble beginnings and, though hard work and enormous talent, bootstrapped himself straight the fuck into the presidency — is the

Sorry Barrack Hussein @BarackObama, Cheesecake Factory has good food and it’s a place Americans can afford. We can’t all be like you and big Mike. You know, with private 5 star chefs who end up drowning and dying while naked in 2 feet of water at our Martha’s Vineyard mansions.

Way to wedge a little transphobia into your tweet, Laura. Awesome job. And let me once again remind everybody that it’s Dear Leader who lives on a golf course, while his estranged Slovenian rent-a-wife has a golden tower in Manhattan all to herself. But sure, let’s pretend the homie who vacations on Martha’s Vineyard is the elitist.

Barack Obama is nothing more than a Martha’s Vineyard elitist hack. Cheesecake Factory serves over 80 million meals a year to Americans. Not everyone can have caviar on the yacht with Clooney. And it’s funny he mentions Saddam Hussein. I guess he forgot his middle name is also Hussein. An odd name for a boy from “Hawaii.”

Of course we know the real reason that the Donnyverse is SIR I AM OUTRAGED about Obama. It’s because, for eight long years, he had the utter temerity to President While Black. How dare he? And he was unapologetic about it. Even worse, he was super fucking good at it.

Every racist lost their mind — and so they had to gin up everything Obama did into some ridiculous fake scandal. He wore a tan suit!

And now, he’s dissed Dear Leader’s vulgar aesthetic.

Fuck straight out of here with your nonsense, you MAGA morons. We’re not buying any today.

You want something to be outraged about? How about the fact that the Donny’s hand-picked Attorney General believes that the Department of Justice has the right to refuse in advance to certify Alaska’s election, but only if the Democrat wins.

BRENNAN: The DOJ lawsuit demands the Alaska result not be certified if voters are confused. The confusion is defined as Sen. Sullivan not winning.

BLANCHE: That’s not what it says

BRENNAN: I'm quoting from it. You are telling them not to certify it. What right does the federal govt have?

I swear, Todd Blanche is Martin Short’s Martin Short’s sweaty, chain-smoking lawyer character, Nathan Thurm, come to life.

You don’t think that Todd Blanche knows that? It’s so funny that you don’t think Todd Blanche knows that.

TRUMP: I looked at his ass, and I've never done that with a man before. By the way, I looked at one hell of a beautiful ass before: Nicki Minaj. That’s hard to miss.

Could Donny please not hold his hands together like that while slobbering over some woman’s butt? It’s embarrassing. And I’m pretty sure I just threw up in my own mouth a little.

One thousand, three hundred and seventy-six words about some imagined slight that Bill Maher perpetrated on Donny.

If you ever needed conclusive proof that Dear Leader’s brain has gone fuckity-bye, it’s this — nobody should be spending this much time thinking about . He’s not worth the effort.

Donny, what the fuck is wrong with you?

Okay, my head’s about to explode, so let’s skip straight to our Heroes of the Day — the voters of Serbia and Brazil.

Serbian strongman Aleksandar Vucic, a nationalist who has cultivated ties to Donald Trump and Vladmir Putin and has downplayed his country’s 1990s war crimes, conceded defeat in elections Sunday to a slate of candidates backed by a student-led anti-corruption movement.

BUENOS AIRES, Argentina (AP) — Brazilian voters have denied Latin America’s resurgent right its ultimate prize, snapping a streak of seven straight conservative presidential victories in 18 months.

Folks, we have our marching orders. In eight days we have the chance to do the entire world a solid, and give them the best anti-authoritarian trifecta ever.

And then, we can get in on a little bit of that spontaneously-fucking-go-nuts action that they’re enjoying in Belgrade right now.

And now, let’s do our Daily Claudia.

Here’s Ms Spouse, pontificating on the patio. Taken last summer, exact date unknown.

And here she is in Stonington, CT, searching for the perfect subject, on September 19, 2019.

And here’s an old-school selfie, taken on November 2, 2016. It’s out of focus, but I don’t care. I just fucking love it.

Have a great Monday, everyone.

items.title: Let’s all watch Barack Obama and Jon Ossoff use Preznit Fuckwit as a chew toy
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
We’re going to get to Barack and Jon’s excellent, I promise.

“Our country is making hundreds of billions of dollars because of what’s happening in the Middle East. They’re making hundreds of billions, our country is, on oil. So, we’re making hundreds and hundreds of billions, trillions of dollars. And my people said ‘please don’t mention that, sir,’ because people are paying a little higher— we’re making money like this country has never made before. The fake news will say ‘he’s bragging about making money, while people are suffering at the— at the’— I can just see the fake headlines. But I don’t give a damn, I’m going to say it. We’re making a frickin’ fortune.”

Mister President, sir — if that really is your name — I have a question: Who the fuck is

Because it sure as hell isn’t . And I know it’s not the average American, sitting at home, trying to figure out which bills to put off paying for another month, to try to make ends meet.

Of course you know who Donny is referring to when he says “we’re making a frickin’ fortune” — he’s talking about himself, his cronies, and his felonious family. That’s all who Donny cares about. We the People can go kick rocks.

‘let them eat fuck-all, I could give a shit.’

How can MAGA just stand there and accept it? You know goddamned well that if Joe Biden’s autopen had ever said such a thing, enraged Republicans, bearing torches and pitchforks, would have stormed the White House.

This isn’t even the first time Donny’s confessed that he literally doesn’t give two shits about average Americans.

When asked by a reporter whether the financial straits of Americans were motivating him to make a deal, Trump replied, “Not even a little bit,” adding, “I don’t think about Americans’ financial situation. I don't think about anybody.”

Isn’t that charming? The US economy may die, but it’s a sacrifice that Dear Leader is willing to make.

What a frickin’ humanitarian.

Okay, onto the frickin’ main event.

Yesterday, at a campaign rally in Ohio, there was a speech given by some rando named hmm, it says here That’s a weird name. Have any of you ever heard of this guy? Let’s hear what this newcomer has to say.

“So when you go through the tally of promises, things have not worked out the way we might have expected. And let’s be honest, does anybody really think that guy in the White House is spending all that time thinking about these issues? I mean, I don’t know if you’ve noticed, but he seems very focused on home renovations. Guy’s building a ballroom that’s bigger than the White House. Paved over the Rose Garden. Put up a helicopter pad on the South Lawn. And there’s gold everywhere. What’s up with the gold? Everything, more gold. He’s got the White House looking like Saddam Hussein opened up a Cheesecake Factory.”

‘Saddam Hussein opened up a Cheesecake Factory’ — hey, that’s not bad. I’m beginning to like this Obama dude. If he keeps this up, he could actually be a good candidate for president someday.

“Meanwhile, you’ve got the Defense Secretary, who’s squarely focused — he’s very focused on important matters, the the jawlines and testosterone levels of our troops. And livestreaming executions — because that’s how he thinks you cultivate that manly warrior spirit. How much time do you think this Defense Secretary spends looking at himself in the mirror in the morning? You know he’s working his hair, because that’s how warriors look. These are not serious people.”

Stop it, Barack —

But this Barack dude has it so right: these are not serious people. None of them are.

Warplans McButtdial is a frickin’ failed weekend chat show host, for frick’s sake. The Transportation Secretary can’t be found, because he’s off doing a reality show that no one watches. The lunatic in charge of our nation’s healthcare swims in sewage and actually believes that heroin, hoovered off the nearest toilet seat, is an effective study aid.

Our chief peace negotiators are a couple of slumlords, and our Secretary of State wears literal oversized clown shoes as he goes about his business of doing— what the fuck is he even doing?

Can you name a single one of his accomplishments? No, you cannot. At least Bobby Brainworms once chainsawed the frickin’ head off a dead whale. That’s something you can point to. What does Liddle Marco Big-Shoes have to brag about?

No wonder our country is in the shitter right now. Not one of these nitwits has any clue what they’re doing.

Okay, Jon Ossoff has been so patient over here, waiting very politely for his turn to talk. Have at it, Jon.

“Now, maybe you saw — the crook president is coming back to Georgia today, to wallow in his failure and disgrace. To remind Georgians of his failure as Commander-in-Chief, and the reckless war that he lied us into that he knows not how to end, or how to win. To remind Georgians of his tariffs that have driven up grocery prices to all-time highs. To remind Georgians that he cut your healthcare and doubled your health insurance premiums. For what? To cut taxes for his donors — for the wealthiest people in the country, and for corporate America. Donald Trump is coming to Georgia today, to remind Georgians that under the failed president Donald J. Trump, it costs more than ever in American history to fill up your truck, to stock your fridge, to power your home, or to go to your doctor.”

I frickin’ adore Jon Ossoff. He doesn’t screw around. He goes straight for the jugular.

And he’s right — Donny a failure. He’s been a failure. Look, owning a casino is like having a license to print money. Yet, this low-wattage stumblefuck somehow managed to bankrupt of them.

Donny wanted to make the midterms all about himself. Fine, let’s give him what he wants. Now smart Democrats like Ossoff can hang Dear Leader’s legacy of abject failure around the neck of every Republican, like the ginormous fucking millstone it is.

Way to act first and think never, Donny.

Oh my god, look who’s up next at the microphone. It’s the Big Dog himself.

“I think Congress made a mistake, not protesting turning the Rose Garden into what looks like the entrance to Liberace's bathroom.”

Okay, that’s pretty, pretty good. Maybe his delivery isn’t quite as polished as that Obama fellow, but if this Bill Clinton character keeps honing his act, he too just might have a bright political future in front of him.

“The radar. My uncle invented radar! Can you believe it? From MIT, Dr. John Trump.”

Donald Trump’s uncle did not invent radar. The “first practical radar system” was patented by Sir Robert Watson-Watt, who built on the work of others such as Heinrich Hertz and Christian Huelsmeyer.

What a weird fucking thing to lie about. Who even gives a shit?

You know, I too have an uncle who went to MIT. I’m not dong a bit right now, I really do have have an uncle who went to MIT. The thing is, I have no idea what he majored in. I never thought to ask — but maybe I’ll start telling people he invented post-its.

Yeah, post-its. That’s the ticket.

And now, it’s time to ourselves the frick out of here.

Here are two shots from an afternoon spent leaf-watching in the Hudson Valley, nine years ago today, on October 25, 2017.

I hear you saying, ‘those pics are from so far away. Don’t you have anything that’s more like, y’know, a closeup?’

Absolutely. Let’s revisit this photo from Ms Spouse’s 66th birthday on February 7, 2016 — because who can resist that ?

Have a great Sunday, everyone.

items.title: This Week in Stupid: October 24 edition
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
As another stupid week comes to a close here in America, let’s look back at the dumbest fucking shit that happened.

Monday: gun 1, dashboard 0

Oh my dear sweet lord, that was satisfying.

Let’s gif that shit for posterity’s sake, and slow it way the fuck down.

Chef’s kiss. Ten out of ten. No notes.

Tuesday: how did we Nazi this coming?

Now let’s all get ready to pick our jaws up off the floor as the Space Nazi proves well beyond any shadow of a doubt that being and being are not mutually exclusive concepts.

“Hitler was a far left socialist. Literally in the name of his party!”

Oh sure, just like North Korea is a democratic republic. Literally in the name of the country!

How can one person be this dumb? How can he be this big a credulous dope? How has Elon not forked his own eye out by now?

Here’s an even better question: why is it that whenever a swastika rears its ugly face in public in America, it’s right next to a Donny banner? That doesn’t sound very leftist to me.

Let’s do this. Let’s turn to an actual expert. I’m talking about the Space Nazi’s own janky, six-fingered plagiarism robot — the one that literally calls itself Mecha-Hitler.

Hitler was a fascist, not a socialist. The Nazi Party’s full name included “socialist” for propaganda appeal to workers, but Hitler explicitly rejected Marxist socialism, class struggle, and internationalism. He purged actual socialists, banned their parties, sent them to camps, allied with industrialists, and privatized industries while preserving private property aligned with state/national goals. Nazism was ultranationalist, racist authoritarianism—far-right fascism in historical consensus, not left-wing socialism.

And, in summation, let me just put this right here, for no particular reason at all.

Wednesday: blessed are

Folks, you better listen up, because god-bothering Donnyvangelist Kenneth Copeland has a stern warning for all you blasphemers who won’t be pulling the lever for Republicans in the midterms: .

“I saw this in the spirit. Literally. Judgement Day. And Jesus stood there, and he said, those of you that didn’t vote, I put you in that nation and you didn’t vote. So you will hear, or you didn’t vote and pray like I told you to. You will listen to the names of all the babies that are here and never got any life. And it’ll take a while, because there’s over 65 million of them. But you are going to listen to every one them, and you are going to be held responsible for their death.”

Wow, Pastor Kenny seems like a real funster, doesn’t he?

I have a question: where is this homie getting his information? Is this in the Gospel of Mark? The Gospel of Luke? Maybe in the Gospel or Some Fucking Tiresome Scold?

Wait, I have an even better question: exactly who is being punished here?

I would imagine that Jesus would have better things to do with his time than read off the names of 65 million aborted fetuses who— wait a minute, they don’t even have names. So are we to believe that Jesus is going to spend eternity going, ‘aborted fetus number three million four hundred and forty-three thousand and seven. Aborted fetus number three million four hundred and forty-three thousand and eight. Aborted fetus—’

Oh please. No way. Jesus doesn’t have time for that shit.

I happen to know for a fact that thee J-Man prefers to spend his free time scrolling through social media and watching videos of dumbfucks blowing away their dashboards.

It’s right there in the Gospel of Jeff.

Thursday: we don’t need no education

Cultist: “We don’t need socialism in this country”

Jason Selvig:

Cultist: “Look what the Democrats are doing. They’ll raise your taxes. They don’t give a shit about the American people”

Selvig:

Cultist: “Look what they’re doing to America. You have all these environmentalist people, they stopped drilling oil wells”

Selvig:

Cultist: “Well look what the Democrats are doing, it’s plain and simple”

Selvig: “But what is the definition of socialism?”

Cultist: “I don’t need to go into big words or whatever. I’m just telling you, we don’t need it in America”

These fucking idiots have no idea what socialism is, nor do they care to know what socialism is. They can only parrot back what they heard Hannity saying on Fox News.

free things from the government is bad — unless it’s that five-thousand dollar check that Dear Leader is never, ever going to send them.

Oh, and speaking of fucking idiots—

Friday: the further adventures of Some Fucking Idiot™

On Friday, while on his way to a hate-rally, some fucking idiot stood up for one of his most-maligned and most-unfairly-treated constituencies: .

Oh look, the fucking idiot took the side of a rapist, he also tried to bully a woman reporter while doing so — !

No, fucking idiot, none of us have ever seen a pile of a million dollars. We’re not the ones trading presidential pardons for cash, remember?

“A healthy person has a thousand dreams. A sick person has only one (to get better)! President DONALD J. TRUMP”

What in the actual fuck? Why is the fucking idiot being so philosophical all of a sudden? Quiet reflection isn’t his thing. Why is he ruminating on mortality? Does the fucking idiot know something about his health that he’s not sharing with the rest of us?

But because the fucking idiot never takes questions from the press while doing a hate-rally, not one reporter had the opportunity to stand up and ask, ‘what the fuck is wrong with you?’

How fucking idiotic is that?

And now, let’s put a close to This Week in Stupid and reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia.

This shot’s from September 2022, and I have no idea where we were. I don’t recognize anything about this interior.

And here’s Ms Spouse, just chilling, on August 19, 2004.

Have a non-stupid Saturday, everyone.

items.title: Boom, there it is: Todd Blanche won’t rule out trying to steal the midterms
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Here’s a super fun story from the early days of Dear Leader’s Fucked-Up States of America. After getting his bloated ass handed to him in the 2020 presidential election, Donny went running to Attorney General William Barr, his hand-picked goon at the Department of Justice, and he was all ‘we gotta do something about this election.’

Barr sighed, looked at Donny, and replied, ‘eat an entire bag of dicks, pal. “We” ain’t gotta do shit.’ And then he resigned.

Billy Bee was an asshole, but he had no desire to be a criminal.

Reporter: “Is there any scenario in which the Department of Justice would try to block states from certifying the election?”

Attorney General Todd Blanche: “Yes, of course. It is not DOJ’s intention to improperly interfere with elections or the state certification process, but ...”

And there it is, folks — the head of the Department of What Used To Be Justice will not rule out meddling in the upcoming midterms.

You have to love how the Toddinator pretends that if he has no choice but to step in and attempt to halt the certification process, it’s because he to. Y’know, for the good of the county.

Look, a man’s gotta do what a man’s gotta do, am I right?

“There was this misperception that there's this ‘separation’ and ‘independence’ between the Department of Justice and the White House and everybody likes to accuse me of not suffering from independence. I don’t. I work for President Trump.”

You keep telling yourself that, honcho, but guess what: BZZT! WRONG ANSWER!

That’s not how this works. That’s not how any of this works.

You know, I’m so old that I remember all the way back to June 27, 2016. That was the day that former president Bill Clinton — who at that point had been out of office for — and then-Attorney-General Loretta Lynch just happened to run into each other, completely by chance, on the tarmac of the Phoenix Sky Harbor International Airport.

All hell broke loose. The entire wingnut outrage-industrial complex shat one massive brick. Breach of ethics! Breach of ethics! All because two old friends happened to run into each other, and shot the breeze for half an hour.

Shut the fuck up, James Comey. You’ve done more to damage our democracy than any random airport meetup did.

Fast forward twenty years, and these same sacred guardians of the media can’t be bothered to utter one word when a corrupt president appoints his personal criminal lawyer to be attorney general, and orders him to do his bidding.

Hey, do any of you assholes care to say anything at all about Toddy and Donny sitting in a tree, c-o-l-l-u-d-i-n-g?

Yes, it’s going to be one nightmarish mess — but when all is said and done, Donny’s just going to be on the losing end of a shitload of poorly-written lawsuits, just as he was in 2024.

None of these Donnyverse fucknozzles have any respect for the offices they hold.

Let me it for you.

Basically, in the Pentagon are two globes that were used by Gen. Dwight D. Eisenhower during World War II. You know, national historical treasures.

Official curators at the Pentagon were all ‘well okay if you must, but these globes are priceless artifacts and fragile as fuck, so let us arrange for professional conservators to move them’ — but Piss-Drunk Pete, because he’s basically a child, started screaming DON’T CARE HOW, I WANT IT NOW, and dispatched a couple of complete randos to fork them globes over to his office, like, RIGHT NOW.

Of course you will absolutely guess what happened next. The randos dropped one of the globes, and broke the shit out of it.

I’m not even sure where ‘destroying a national treasure’ goes, on a scale of ‘butt-dialing classified war plans to a reporter’ to ‘starting an unwinnable war that fucks the entire world’s economy straight into the shitter’ — but holy moly, these incompetent numbskulls can’t do right.

That was Donny and his diaper nurse, once again shitting out nonsense in the middle of the night. Oh look, Donny wants you to know that his beloved Epstein Reflecting Pool is ‘85% full.’

Of course, it’s all nonsense. The Pool hasn’t been ‘broken since 1922.’ That was the year it was . And he’s still blaming imaginary vandals for his own clowntastic screw-up. And who even knows what the fuck Donny is blithering about when he blames dead grass on ‘a large, and very inappropriate, phrase’?

Shut up, Donny. a large and very inappropriate phrase.

But Donny wants a cookie, for taking months to fix the thing he broke for absolutely no reason at all.

Natty, could you please give this idiot his cookie, and put him to bed? We’re all tired and we really could use some peace and quiet.

Let me leave you with this dollop of .

“You might have known, you might have seen yesterday, we had a little debate. Or, I had a debate, and he just pointed at me and said, ‘well, he’s a Muslim.’”

“His cadence during this was so much like Obama’s, and I love it.”

Holy shit, they’re right. El-Sayed have the cadences — and vocal range — of Barack Obama. How had I never noticed it before?

I don’t know if El-Sayed is doing this on purpose, or if it’s just a random coincidence, it’s effective. No wonder we love this guy so much. Not only does he says the right things, he says them just as that other guy we love would have.

Take a listen. You can’t un-hear it.

Well, it’s Friday — and we made it through another week in one piece. Let’s reward ourselves with some Daily Claudia and get out of here.

Here are a couple of pics from December 1983, taken by Ms Spouse’s bestie Mandi, in Mandi’s Greenwich Village apartment.

Have a great Friday, everyone.

items.title: Preznit Fuckwit knows he’s losing his mind, and it’s scaring him shitless
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Dear Leader’s brain has gone .

You know it, and I know it.

The worthless scribblers of the corporate-controlled press know it, too, though they try like hell to dance around the subject.

The GOP establishment — lickspittles and bottom-feeders like Holy Mike Johnson and John Thune — they know it, too. But their political futures depend on pretending it’s not happening.

Here’s the real question, though — does Dear Leader understand just how cognitively collapsed he is?

Consider this: when Lord Shitticus, lost in a thick haze of dementia, wanders past the open door of his waiting limo, as he did the other night, and then snaps back to reality to find himself in the middle of a field, surrounded his panicked security contingent — the deteriorating old dumbfuck has to realize that something is seriously wrong, doesn’t he?

“But my wife, uh— said to me— I mimicked Sleepy Joe walking off the stage, you know, I had a wall behind me in that case, and I walked into the wall. You know, walked around aimlessly. Had no idea. And— I thought it was— the place was cracking up, right? And then I came back and I finished my speech, and I said, ‘baby, how good was that tonight? Was that the best? No one can do it like me, baby. You see that crowd?’ And she said, ‘what happened to you? Are you okay?’ I said, ‘what do you mean?’ ‘They had you walking around the stage, hitting the wall. Are you okay, darling?’”

Oh look, it’s a — the first-lady-themed version of a Whenever Donny recounts a tale wherein the Slovenian rent-a-wife who despises him and recoils at his touch calls him ‘darling’ — that’s when you know it’s a big ball of No, Melania did not come up to Donny after his speech, big, strong, teary-eyed like few thought possible, and go, ‘Donal! Donal! Vat wrong vit you oh my darlink Donal?’

Let’s get real. Mel doesn’t live with Donny. She doesn’t travel with him. If anyone come up to Donny and express concern after a speech, it would have been Diaper Nurse Natty.

But what you really have to love is how Donny blames his inability find his way off the stage on Joe Biden. Sleepy Joe made me do it!

“I’d say 90% of the reason I took the governor— EUHHHP.”

Fuck me, what even was that sound? Did Donny just cough up a hairball?

Donny’s losing the ability to make his rancid anus-mouth function properly. But please, Donny, tell us one more time now you were just imitating Joe Biden. That’s such a cool story.

“I settled all these wars, and— they gave the— wonderful PEACE prize, right? Does anyone know the name of that peace prize? The peace prize. They gave the Pulitzer Prize to— a YOUNG LADY. I think she’s eighty years old. A young lady who— nobody ever heard of.”

It’s the Nobel Peace Prize, you sub-sentient suppurating pustule. How do you fuck that up? There is no Pulitzer Peace Prize. The Pulitzer committee doesn’t dole out prizes for peacefully-written sentences. Did Joe Biden’s autopen make you say that?

Donny’s barely coherent — and I’m being generous when I say ‘barely.’ He now speaks in that weird, halting syntax, full of odd pauses and nonsensically emphasized words. Take a gander at the crowed of numbskulls behind Dear Leader. They’re completely checked out. They didn’t sign up for this. They came to be entertained, but now they’re just confused.

Look at this bro behind Donny. He so fucking bored that he can’t stop yawning.

All he can think is ‘when will this shit be over?’ Yeah, that’s one motivated Republican voter, right there.

Look, I understand that Donny to be holding these hate-rallies, night after night, right up to the midterms. But he can’t hack it any more. Letting him do this to himself is just elder abuse at this point. He should be back at the White House, with the diaper nurse spoon-feeding him from a pudding cup.

President Trump’s approval rating hit a new low just weeks before the midterm elections, driven by broad disapproval of his handling of the economy, the war in Iran and high gas prices, according to a new poll from The New York Times and Siena University.

Fox News: “There’s a potential President Trump visit to Minnesota. Would that help or hurt you?”

Michele Tafoya: “Listen, uh, I don’t know anything about his schedule. I'm certainly not in charge of his schedule.” She then goes on to change the subject — but the Fox bobblehead is having none of it.

Fox: “But would he help your case?”

Tafoya: “Look, again, I think for some it might, and for some it might not.”

Look at that — when asked to commit to a straightforward answer — yes or no — Brave Sir Michele runs away, away.

In any other election cycle, having the sitting president come to personally campaign for you would be a boon — but not in 2026. Donny is a toxic waste dump. He’s a superfund cleanup site.

Let’s move from 2026 to 2028, because here’s another question for you: who do you see as the GOP front-runner for prez? Oh sure, Couchfuck McGee, Piss-Drunk Pete, and Liddle Marco Big-Shoes all want to president, but let’s face it — none of those clowns has a snowball’s chance. They’re all repellent.

Reporter: “Mr. President, since we have the vice president here, the vice president said in an interview yesterday, that he thought you would endorse him if he does decide to run in 2028. Since we’re here, could you tell us—”

Donny: “Well, I’ll tell you. There’s— he’s a very talented person and he’s a good person, but we’ve literally— I don’t think we’ve ever talked about it. Who would believe that.”

How humiliating for Couchfuck McGee. All he can do is stand behind Dear Leader, with a fake smile plastered on his stupid face, and croak out an insincereEven his lord and master knows he’s a fucking loser.

Here’s the thing: the GOP has no rising young stars. They have no future. Donny’s made sure of that, by running anyone with half a brain right out of the party. It’s shitwits and fucksticks all the way down.

Reporter: “There was a report in Politico the other day that FEMA is telling states to begin to prepare to handle disasters on their own. Do you have reaction to this?”

Jon Ossoff: “So the Trump administration is telling folks across the country to prepare to fend for themselves if a natural disaster hits while taxpayer dollars are sent to back Don Jr and Eric's mining interest in Kazakhstan?”

As I never tire of saying, Jon Ossoff is so good at this. No matter what the subject, he’ll masterfully tie it to the high crimes and corruption of Donny and his felonious family.

Ask him what time it is, and he’ll be all, ‘it’s Donny is a thieving bastard o’clock.’

I’m liking our chances in 2026 — and I’m liking our chances in 2028.

And I’m liking the Daily Claudia, so let’s have one.

items.title: Agolf Shitler commits another fascism. How did we Nazi it coming?
items.author: Jeff Tiedrich
items.content:
Folks, you can say what you want about Preznit Fuckwit, but you can’t deny that the dude is a bottomless well of super-awesome ideas.

Let’s threaten and alienate all our allies. Let’s throw Ukraine to the wolves, and give Putin everything he wants. Let’s bomb the shit out of Venezuelan fishermen.

Let’s allow masked federal thugs to roam the streets of our cities, and look the other way when they gun down anyone they want. Let’s smash half the White House to rubble, and put up a vulgar, heavily-militarized Epstein Dance Hall in its place. Let’s clownfuck ourselves into an unwinnable war that ends up making everything unaffordable.

Let’s encourage Americans to rat each other out for fun and profit.

Wait, what was that last one? Americans should do what?

“So today, I’m thrilled to announce the— Fraud Whistle— Blower Incentive— Program. Fraud— Whistle— Blower Incentive Program. Annnnnnd— mark those words. Independent journalists and every— body and all Americans will now be able to go to the— fraud dot gov and report cases of corruption and theft of taxpayer dollars in their communities ... if you turn somebody in and you find $1 billion, we’re giving a commission of 1%. That's a lot of money,”

Really? We’re paying bounties on fraudsters now? Because I know a guy who sleep-farted his way through an entire trial, and then got convicted on 34 counts of fraud. He’s still walking the streets, and he’s still criming. Can I turn this narcoleptic fuckface in, and glom some reward?

The Donnyverse doesn’t intend for this new whistleblower thingumbob to be used against — and certainly not against .

“They came here from Somalia, they’re living here for a year or two, they say ‘I’m going to open up a fake daycare. I’ll tell Keith Ellison, I’ll tell Governor Walz, I’m taking care of 200 kids. Send me a check for thirty million dollars. What do they do? They buy Mercedes, they buy BMWs. They buy a mansion, they buy a nice house. All their kids fly first class all over the world. They are living the high life.”

Wait, is that true? Let’s do a quick fact check:

this isn’t happening. It’s a fever-swamp fairy tale cooked up by white supremacists.

The reality is that every accusation Nosferatu just shat our of his undead mouth is actually being perpetrated right now by Preznit Fuckwit’s two felonious failsons — Cokey McSniffles, and the dumb one.

A report released Thursday details how the family of President Donald Trump “pocketed more than $2.9 billion”—including “in cash and gifts from crypto ventures, legal settlements, a luxury jet from a foreign government, and corporate deals”—while Republican cuts to the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program left millions of Americans without critical food aid.

Can I turn them in?

Pick a lane, racists — are these Somalis all on welfare, or are they all buying luxury items? Because — spoiler alert — it can’t be both.

Folks, this is straight up Nazi bullshit — because you know who else used to pay people to rat out the undesirables in their midst, don’t you? Of course you do.
